title: Drone survey shows rust-like lines and cracks on the object

tellings.quote: We saw some weird lines. Yeah. Some cracks. Yeah. And something I would say it was like rust. Like metal.

plain: In 2025 an underwater drone was sent down to the Baltic Sea anomaly, a strange object on the floor of the Baltic Sea that some call a UFO, and its pictures showed odd lines, cracks and something that looked like rusting metal. The treasure hunter Dennis Asberg, who was part of the survey, tells Michels: "We saw some weird lines. Yeah. Some cracks... something I would say it was like rust. Like metal." If he is right, the object would be something made rather than natural rock.
